CREATE A LASTING MEMORY
         Girdwood Playground Maintenance
               FENCE PICKET FUNDRAISER

                                Girdwood residents built a wonderful
                                   playground from the ground up in 2006.
                              The Little Bears Park always needs
                                 maintenance support…and you can be a big
                                        part of it!

                       We would like to extend an offer for you to
                                  donate a piece of it.

                       We are offering a sponsorship of the fence
                                    surrounding the park.

                       We are selling personalized “Fence Pickets"!


          Pickets are $25 each (blue letters) or $50 each (golden letters) for individuals/families.
          Pickets are $100 each for businesses (red/white/blue letters).
              Pickets can be donated in multiples, but we can not guarantee that they will be placed together in the installation

        You may contact Kyle Kelley at 350-6302 with any questions. Your support is greatly
           appreciated!

         The “Fence Pickets” will be 3 ½ “ by 48” and will allow for up to 17 letters (all CAPS), please specify
          below what you would like it to say (i.e. Emma, Nina, & Tom; or Quincy Smith)…
